info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Term Deposit Framework Agreement Management API
info.description: This API enables financial institutions to manage term deposit framework agreements efficiently. Users can update existing agreements to reflect changes in terms or conditions, ensuring compliance with evolving regulations or client needs. Typical users include banking operators and compliance teams who require precise control over contract details. The API streamlines the lifecycle management of term deposits, facilitating better financial planning and customer service.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific Term Deposit Framework Agreement identified by its resource ID. Ensure that the payload contains valid fields for the agreement to be updated correctly.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information for updating a term deposit framework agreement identified by RES-100045. The structure of the payload must conform to the defined schema to ensure successful processing of the operation.
